glance_takeaway: This page reports an A/B test of a redesigned onboarding flow called 'Pathways.' The overall conversion lift (+0.8pp, 11.4% to 12.2%) is not statistically significant, so the headline warns not to read it as a win. The real finding is a platform split — mobile-web improved strongly (+4.2pp) while iOS significantly regressed (-1.9pp) — so the recommendation is to ship Pathways on mobile-web only, hold it on iOS pending a fix to a step-3 notification prompt, and leave Android unchanged; early-week gains were novelty-inflated and the retention guardrail was flat.

F2.note: Lede and first section: '95% CI of [-0.3, +1.9] and p = 0.16 ... not statistically significant ... straddles zero'.

F3.note: 'measured on all 184,204 randomized users' (guardrails); trial-starter counts appear per platform in the table (sum to 6,602/6,647 = 13,249); the explicit 92,114/92,090 arm split is not stated.

F4.note: 'the experiment had 80% power to detect an overall lift of +1.55pp; it simply was not sized to confirm effects around +0.8pp'.

F5.note: 'Platform was the single pre-registered subgroup dimension (chosen before launch...)'; trust callout adds 'not discovered by scanning many cuts'.

F6.note: Table row: 13.9% / 18.1% / +4.2 / [+2.1, +6.3] / <0.0001; callout: 'mobile-web survives easily' under Bonferroni.

F7.note: Table row: 11.6% / 9.7% / -1.9 / [-3.6, -0.2] / 0.027; callout correctly notes iOS does not survive Bonferroni but is credible via pre-registration + mechanism.

F9.note: 'reconcile arithmetically with the blended +0.8pp. The overall number is a win and a loss averaging each other out'; also 'not a modest win everywhere'.

F10.note: Novelty section gives +2.9pp week 1 to +0.1pp week 6 with the full weekly sequence (+2.9, +1.5, +0.6, 0.0, -0.4, +0.1).

F11.note: 'The platform split is not explained by novelty' — weeks 4-6 pooled: mobile-web +3.8pp, iOS -2.2pp, flagged as exploratory.

F12.note: '7-day retention was flat: 31.2% (A) vs 31.4% (B), +0.2pp, CI [-0.2, +0.6]'; tickets +12% weeks 1-2 then normalized from week 3.

F13.note: 'time-to-first-lesson improved by 38 seconds (4m 52s -> 4m 14s, CI [-45, -31])'; trial-start rate flat 7.17% vs 7.22% with the denominator-soundness point made.

F14.note: Bullets: iOS step-3 drop-off 8.1% -> 12.7%; mobile-web 3.2% -> 3.4%; Android 5.0% -> 5.6%; OS-dialog mechanism explained.

F15.note: Recommendation list: ship mobile-web only with 5% holdback, do not ship iOS (follow-up ONB-2026-019 with reverted/softened prompt), do not ship Android; diagnostics clean (SRM p = 0.96, audit clean) in secondaries.

strengths: Every one of the 15 key facts survives with correct numbers, directions, and significance status; nothing is oversold — the headline itself is the anti-overclaim ('don't read the overall number as a win').

Caveats are first-class content: a dedicated callout handles the Bonferroni/multiple-comparisons question honestly in both directions, exploratory analyses are labeled as such, and the confounded dismissed-vs-accepted comparison is explicitly flagged as non-causal.

The lede front-loads all four required takeaways above the fold, and plain-language explanations (what a CI means, why the experiment was underpowered for +0.8pp) fit the PM-with-basic-stats audience.
The platform table is clean and correct, with CI and p columns and bolded significant deltas.
weaknesses: Almost no visual encoding of the data: no chart of the novelty decay series, and CIs that straddle zero look identical (as text) to CIs that do not — the one thing the brief says must be visible at a glance is conveyed only through numerals and prose.
Above-the-fold is a wall of prose; a genuine 10-second glance likely captures the headline and bold block (T1, T2, T4) but the novelty takeaway (T3) sits in unformatted body text.
The 'Guardrails and secondaries' section packs retention, tickets, time-to-first-lesson, trial-start rate, and diagnostics into one long paragraph — hard to re-find a specific figure later.
No table of contents or summary stat block; wayfinding relies entirely on section headings and linear reading.
evaluator_notes: Fact audit: 15/15 conveyed, 0 distorted, 0 contradicted -> accuracy = 10 x 15/15 = 10.0. Overall = 0.35*10.0 + 0.30*7.5 + 0.15*7.5 + 0.10*6.5 + 0.10*5.5 = 8.075 -> 8.1. The page is a model of factual and rhetorical honesty and the mechanical accuracy formula rewards that; the deductions concentrate where they belong for this project — visual conveyance. It communicates through typography and prose alone, leaving the CI-straddles-zero contrast and the week-by-week decay pattern unvisualized. density_fit (6.5) reported but not part of overall: appropriate front-loading, but total length runs past the 'couple of minutes' reading goal for a PM.
